REPRODUCTION: Clause [121] lease bindings do not include Mission Fence STATE_VERSION, mission stop state, or gate state.
Clause [166] requires USER_STOP through Mission Fence CAS but does not state that STOP entry changes ENGINEERING_EPOCH or MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH.

Clause [220] revalidates mission/law/spec/resource/membership/task/lease generations, but it does not include USER_STOP, MISSION_STATUS, WORK_ADMISSION_GATE, MUTATION_GATE, or Mission Fence STATE_VERSION in the final revalidation set immediately before IMPLEMENT.
Therefore a STOP CAS that only changes stop/transition/gate state can leave every explicit [121]/[220] lease binding unchanged while a worker proceeds from a prior successful revalidation.

STOP_LINEARIZATION_CAS: Atomically set mission/Bootstrap stop state to STOPPING.
Atomically close WORK_ADMISSION_GATE, MUTATION_GATE, and INTEGRATION_GATE.
Increment or create a monotonic STOP_GENERATION bound to the stop transition.
AUTHORITY_EFFECT: All pre-stop leases become stale at the STOP CAS linearization point.
All pre-stop ACTIVE memberships lose mutation eligibility through the membership-epoch change.

Any worker-branch write physically produced after the stop linearization point from stale local state is an unauthorized/noncanonical stale artifact and can never enter integration-ready or ACTIVE_INTEGRATION state.
Recovery/audit must preserve such durable writes as evidence rather than treating them as authorized progress.
VALIDATOR_HARDENING: Add Mission Fence STATE_VERSION or STOP_GENERATION plus MISSION_STATUS/EXECUTION_PHASE and MUTATION_GATE to mutation-admission validation.
Immediately before any mutation operation, reject STOPPING/STOPPED, MUTATION_GATE != OPEN, stale ENGINEERING_EPOCH, stale MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH, or stale STOP_GENERATION.
Integration intent must also bind STOP_GENERATION or equivalent fence generation so pre-stop candidates cannot become newly authoritative after STOP.

LAW_INTERPRETATION: The epoch/gate invalidation is a control implementation of existing [164] immediate/preemptive stop semantics and [122]-[123] stale-authority rules. If the system instead requires a guarantee that no physical worker-branch Git write can occur after the STOP linearization point, that stronger sink-level atomicity is not established by V16-RC1.3 and requires an explicit successor-law contract or a mutation sink capable of atomic fence enforcement.
DISPOSITION: Keep STATIC_PROTOCOL_P0 blocking until canonical STOP transition semantics are repaired, independently tested under race, and the finding is resolved or superseded.
